Title: GLP-1 Shots and Sudden Vision Loss - What a 2024 Harvard Study Found

Description:
If you're on a GLP-1 weight loss shot like Ozempic or Wegovy and one eye suddenly blurs or part of your vision goes dark, don't brush it off. A 2024 Harvard Medical School study found semaglutide users face a higher risk of NAION, a condition where blood flow to the optic nerve gets cut off - sometimes called a 'stroke of the eye.' Here's what raises the risk and when to see an eye doctor right away.

On a GLP-1 weight loss shot and one eye suddenly went blurry? 👁️

A 2024 Harvard study found semaglutide users face a higher risk of NAION - a condition where blood flow to the optic nerve gets cut off, sometimes called a 'stroke of the eye.' Risk climbs with rapid weight/blood sugar drops, starting after age 55, or existing diabetes.

Get a baseline eye exam before starting, and if vision changes hit, see an eye doctor the same day.
